title: Junior Email Support - Fresher's can apply
description:
**About Poshmark**
------------------

  

**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection.** Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

  

Poshmark is the largest community marketplace for fashion where anyone can buy, sell and share their personal style. With millions of shoppers and seller stylists, Poshmark brings together a vibrant community every day to express themselves and share their love of fashion.

As a **Community Associate, Disputes** you are responsible for providing front-line customer support to our growing Community. You will triage and respond to high volumes of time-sensitive customer inquiries-related to orders, their account, and provide detailed product education. Our goal is to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction while assisting with a seamless user experience. Your ability to investigate, resolve issues, and communicate effectively will be critical in maintaining Poshmark’s high standards of customer satisfaction.

**The ideal Community Associate...**

* understands empathy is the key to helping others
* exercises strong problem-solving skills
* showcases endless patience and contagious positive energy
* has excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Is self motivated and thrives working independently.

**Responsibilities:**

* Engage with Poshmark users regarding dispute cases via email support
* Investigate all aspects of an order and find resolutions for dispute cases filed by buyers
* Respond to users in a timely, friendly, and professional manner
* Execute decisions to fairly resolve disputes following Poshmark’s return policies
* Communicate with Poshmark users in a friendly, helpful, and patient manner via email
* Gather feedback and suggestions from the Community
* Strive to exceed Volume, First Response Time, Resolution Rate and CES (Customer Effort Score) goals
* Flexibility to work on holidays and occasional overtime, as required.

**Requirements:**

* **Overnight shift**: 7:30pm/9:30pm/11:30pm Sun-Thurs/Tues-Sat/Fri-Tues
* **AUS shift**: 3:30am IST Sun-Thurs/Tues-Sat/Fri-Tues
* 0-3 years of equivalent experience in customer service or community support, particularly in e-commerce. Customer service via email using Salesforce or previous support experience dealing with US-Based customers preferred; new college graduates are encouraged to apply
* Strong Macbook navigation and typing skills
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with keen attention to detail
* Willing to work on holidays and provide support over weekends, as required
* Problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Ability to collaborate and interact with managers and peers primarily from the US office headquarters with professionalism
* Enthusiastic about community, customer service, and spreading love and kindness
* Endless patience and a positive attitude with the ability to turn a negative into a positive.
* Competitive by nature; thrives off the success of a team
* Believes that helping users is crucial to the growth and success of the company

**6-Month Accomplishments:**

* Independently handle trained cases with efficiency and accuracy
* Provide resolutions based on guidelines and policies
* Meet daily case goals on a consistent basis

**12+ Month Accomplishments:**

* Navigate assigned Tier cases with ease
* Absorbed tier knowledge without depending on resources
* Meeting and or exceeding all performance metrics

title: Lead- Project Management
description:
IMI plc

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world — creating lasting impact for everyone.

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control, and Transport.

Process Automation is a world leading provider of flow control solutions for critical applications across the Energy, Marine and Pharmaceutical markets.

  

**Role Overview**

* This position will be responsible for the smooth execution of all projects. She/he will support the manager in maintaining constraints of cost, time, scope and quality of a project. This individual strives to maintain the progress and mutual interaction and tasks of various parties in such a way that reduces the risk of overall failure and maximizes benefits. This position will take ownership of assigned projects from the CORB stage until the order is commercially closed.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a diverse, dynamic, and fun global team that likes to challenge the status quo with new ideas and maximum creativity.

* Strong Career progression opportunities.

* A company culture of promotions from within.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Updating the project financials in ERP system and continuously monitoring

* Provide monthly reports to Manager 6 Customer on project progress

* Support PM in Project Planning 6 Scheduling, Cost Control, Revenue Planning

* Support PM in Project Progress Review Meetings with Team, Customer 6 Consultant

* Coordinates work of engineering, quality assurance, purchasing production, shipping and finance to implement fulfilment of contracts.

* Transmits drawings, data sheets, calculations, process procedures, test and progress reports and other exhibits as required by contract and follows up with customer for appropriate action — revising and resubmitting documents as required

* Support PM in Project Reviews.

* Billing Plan Preparation 6 Approval with Customer.

* Project document deliverable monitoring.

* Billing Submission, Payment Receivables Management

* Post Commissioning Support to Customer

* Travel to customer/site, based on requirement of projects.

  

Critical Competencies for Success

* Knowledge of ERP systems.

* Good Business communication.
* Interpersonal skills.

* MS Projects knowledge is desirable.

* Well verse in MS Office.

* BE (Mechanical/ Electrical/ Metallurgy Engineering) with 8 to107 years post qualification experience.

* IFS/SAP system knowledge desired

* Ability to adhere to international business protocol (etiquette, time differences, etc.)

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally 20% of time.

* PMP Certified/To be certified in coming 1 year.

* Must possess good writing and communication skills.

* Dynamic, well spoken, Self-motivated and pro-active.

* Willing to learn fast and put into practice.

* Self-disciplined and respect to processes.

  

IMI is an inclusive employer; diversity is very important to us, and we want to receive applications from people from all backgrounds

title: Senior Corporate Sales Manager - Banca (Sr.CSM)
description:
### **What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a highly experienced and results-driven Sr. Corporate Sales Manager (Sr.CSM) to lead our Bancassurance team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of driving sales growth, building strong relationships with key clients, and navigating complex sales processes. The Sr. CSM will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing and executing sales strategies, and managing a team of sales professionals to achieve sales targets. The candidate should possess excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills, with a deep understanding of the bancassurance industry.

### **What does the job entail?**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to drive revenue growth in the Bancassurance department
* Lead and manage a team of sales representatives to achieve sales targets and expand market share
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including banks and financial institutions
* Analyze market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for growth
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing and product development, to drive business growth
* Develop and implement sales plans, forecasts, and budgets to ensure alignment with business objectives
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities, including partnerships and joint ventures
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to inform sales strategies
* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the Bancassurance market and industry trends
* Achieve and exceed sales targets, with a focus on revenue growth and market share expansion

### **Work Experience**

8 - 15 Years

### **Essential Qualification**

Graduation

### **Preferred Skills**

* Strategic planning and execution of sales strategies to achieve business objectives
* Leadership and management of sales teams to drive performance and growth
* Development and implementation of sales processes and procedures
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including customers and partners
* Identification and pursuit of new business opportunities
* Negotiation and closing of large-scale deals
* Analysis and reporting of sales performance and market trends
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive business growth
* Identifying and addressing sales process inefficiencies and areas for improvement
* Developing and managing sales budgets and forecasts

title: Head of CBB - India
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary technology executive to serve as **Head of Technology – Consumer Banking, Business Banking & Digital (CBB), India**. This executive will lead the India-based engineering organization supporting the bank's Consumer Banking, Business Banking, and Money Movement products & platforms.

As a key member of the global CBB technology leadership team and the India GCC Technology leadership team, this leader will be responsible for building and scaling world-class engineering capabilities, driving digital transformation, modernizing platforms, accelerating product delivery, and establishing India as a strategic innovation and engineering hub.

The role requires an exceptional combination of technology expertise, organizational leadership, talent development, and executive stakeholder management. The successful candidate will partner closely with global business technology leaders to deliver customer-centric solutions, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the bank's digital capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology and Engineering Leadership**

* Partner with global CBB Technology and product leaders to align technology investments with strategic business priorities.
* Build, scale, and lead a high-performing engineering organization across Consumer, Business, and Digital Banking domains.
* Establish India as a strategic engineering center capable of owning products, platforms, and critical enterprise capabilities.
* Foster a strong engineering culture focused on accountability, craftsmanship, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer obsession.
* Drive engineering productivity through modern tools, automation, AI-assisted development, and platform standardization.
* Create an environment that attracts, retains, and develops exceptional technology talent.

**Talent Strategy & Organizational Development**

* Lead multiple engineering managers, directors, architects, and distinguished technologists.
* Develop a multi-year workforce strategy to build sustainable technology capabilities within the GCC.
* Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development programs.
* Mentor and coach senior technology leaders while building a robust leadership pipeline.
* Drive transformation from contractor-heavy teams toward a strategically balanced permanent workforce model.
* Build a culture of learning, innovation, inclusion, and continuous professional development.

**GCC and Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary technology leader for India supporting global Consumer Banking, Business Banking, and Digital executives.
* Play a key role in the expansion and maturation of the GCC as a strategic technology center.
* Build trusted relationships with CBB CIO and Technology leadership, Business Leaders, Product Leaders, Risk Partners, and Operations stakeholders.
* Influence strategic decisions through data, technology insights, and strong business partnership.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership regarding strategy, delivery performance, technology risk, and transformation progress.
* Drive outcomes through collaboration and influence across highly matrixed global organizations.

**Risk, Security & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure technology solutions comply with regulatory requirements, enterprise standards, and risk management frameworks.
* Partner closely with Information Security, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit teams.
* Strengthen resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational readiness capabilities.
* Maintain rigorous controls appropriate for a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent in related field.
* 20+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, technology delivery, and digital transformation.
* 15+ years of leadership experience managing large engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated success managing complex global technology organizations – prefer Bank’s GCC.
* Proven experience leading senior technology leaders, engineering managers, and architects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Technology & Engineering**

* Strong understanding of AI-enabled software development and engineering productivity tools.
* Strong background in software delivery, platform engineering, Dev/ML Ops, Site Reliability Engineering, and technology operations.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
* Expertise in Agile product development methodologies and engineering excellence frameworks.

**Banking & Financial Services**

* knowledge of Consumer Banking, Business Banking, Digital Banking and Money Movement technologies.
* Experience supporting customer-facing digital channels and financial products.
* Strong understanding of regulatory, risk, compliance, and security requirements within financial institutions.
* Experience operating in highly regulated environments.

**Leadership**

* Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations with 500+ technology professionals.
* Exceptional ability to influence senior executives and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Demonstrated success in talent development, succession planning, and organizational transformation.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape the future of the bank's consumer, business and digital technology landscape while building one of the industry's most impactful banking technology organizations in India.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Technology Mgr
description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Definition  
Leads and develops Systems Engineering teams across Engine Installation, Hydraulics Installation, Electrical Installation, Heavy Structures, Light Fabrications, and Work Tools, supporting MWL products across NPI, NTI, and Current Product Maintenance. Provides technical leadership and drives effective execution of product development, system integration, validation, production support, and continuous product improvement.

Responsibilities  

* Managing staffing, development, and performance management programs for engineering teams; motivating and developing project and team leaders.
* Providing specialized engineering technical support and consulting services to various areas of the organization.
* Assisting with high-impact, long duration engineering initiatives and projects; ensuring achievement of engineering plan and product quality.
* Maintaining product release plans and material plans; driving programs to completion on time and within budget.

  
Degree Requirement

Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum. Preferably Mechanical or Electrical Engineering  
  
Skill Descriptors

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Facilitates creation of the 'right' products and services to resolve customer business issues.
* Fosters strong customer relationships via delivery on commitments, open communication, and on-going feedback/improvement.
* Advises others on creating customer focused environments in various scenarios.
* Anticipates customer needs, focusing efforts to proactively meet needs and exceed customer expectations.
* Measures and observes customer satisfaction levels to ascertain and implement service improvement alternatives.
* Communicates and models the criticality of customer focus as an organizational strategy.

  
Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Contributes to short-term operational plans.
* Anticipates and adapts to plan changes.
* Monitors progress of work against plan as required to meet objectives.
* Reports variances and makes agreed-upon corrections.
* Under guidance, develops tactical plan for own direct responsibility.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyse situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
* Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
* Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

  
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyses and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

  
Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions.
* Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues.
* Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions.
* Coaches others in promoting, defining, analysing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems.
* Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
* Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs.

Managing People: Knowledge of processes involved in managing people; ability to lead successful teams, and diligently address issues related to performance and conflicts at the workplace.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Assesses the amount of time and resources needed to accomplish a task; delegates work accordingly.
* Explains how the team's work contributes to the success of the organization; creates a shared vision.
* Reviews progress and performance of employees; addresses bottlenecks or concerns impending employee growth.
* Uses multiple channels such as meetings, e-mails, newsletters to communicate important messages with the team regularly.
* Works with employees to set and define performance standards and career development goals; supports in achieving them.

  
Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Develops organizational standards and processes in order to maximize complex product services' efficiency and effectiveness.
* Creates and introduces new techniques that expedite or simplify the development process.
* Supervises the management of multiple and diverse types of products or services.
* Develops proof-of-concept exercises to prove or disprove validity of proposed products.
* Advises on the appropriate solutions to complex product design and development problems.
* Designs working prototypes of a variety of proposed products or services.

  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Posting Dates:**

October 15, 2026 - October 22, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Manager - Application Engineering (Projects)
description:
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Manage workload, performance review of sub-ordinates & manage metrices for the team
* Set-Monitor-Improve Team KPIs Metrics on Error, Productivity, Hit Rate & Service levels.
* Review & measure all the quotation prepared by team members.
* To work with Sales & Industry teams on fixing the AE Selection guidelines & alternate proposals on a project with increased complexity, lead time & cost
* Ensure AE Selection guidelines are set and documented prior to all project’s quotations.
* Drive MIB & New product selection opportunities in quote strategy.
* Project Lead for high-priority projects as consultant, prepare technical/commercial quote and attend customer meets when required.
* Act as a Trainer in conducting technical trainings to Project teams.
* To prepare & document Order Entry guidelines upon project award and engage in post order activities till shipment.
* Ensure Stakeholders satisfaction & drive continuous improvements to enhance quality and productivity

  

**Who You Are:**

You keep in touch with customers, build the customer relationships, understand the importance and interdependence of internal customer relationships, balance planning with actions, research initiatives and try new approaches, You stay aligned with your goals and stay productive, focus on priorities and set stretch goals, apply systems and technology to stay on track, convert ideas into actions and produce results with new initiatives.

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Minimum 15 years’ experience in Control valves engineering
* In depth knowledge of control valve products and industry application
* Knowledge on Fisher products and accessories would be a plus.
* Experience of reviewing Control valve project specifications.
* Optimizes work processes and improves performance metrics.
* Expert on all Fisher products, sizing techniques and tools.
* Provides feedback to Business on Products Gaps, Competition and enhance sales tools.
* Fisher Red Belt certified, Hands-on experience of PRESTO tool would be added advantages.
* Experience of leading AE team of over 10 Engineers in past would be added advantage

  

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* + Degree in Mechanical/Instrumentation/Chemical/Metallurgical Engineering.
  + Time management, Problem Solving and decision-making Skills
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  + Customer Centric Approach & persuasive ability
  + Ready to take up any new challenges.
  + Good collaborative approach and team building ability to achieve common goal

  

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**

* At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

  

**WHY EMERSON**

**Our Commitment to Our People**

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

**Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation**

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

**ABOUT EMERSON**

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Engineer - L3 Observability
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies.
* Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles.
* Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented.
* Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads.
* Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends.
* Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management.
* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices).
* Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout.
* Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including:
* Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups.
* APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments.
* Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs.
* Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance.
* SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level.
* Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments.
* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.
* Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units.

**Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic)**

* Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers.
* Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging.
* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents.
* Strong documentation and process-governance discipline.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Work Details**

* **Level:** L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations
* **Reporting To:** Observability Practice Lead / Delivery Manager

  

**Your future at Presidio**  
Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers - thinkers, builders, and collaborators - who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital world.

Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.

**Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next-together.**

  

**About Presidio**  
Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.

* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Service, Clinical, Finance, and Legal to deliver customer\-centric solutions.

* Hands\-on experience with **Government Tenders, GeM, Rate Contracts, DME/DHS, AIIMS, ESIC, Railways, Defence, and other Central/State Government institutions**.
* Strong expertise in strategic account management, stakeholder engagement, negotiation, business planning, and payment collection.
* Bachelor's degree in Science, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline; **MBA preferred**.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior decision\-makers, build long\-term partnerships, and drive growth in complex Government healthcare environments.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Manager, Corporate Strategy
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


This job identifies issues and recommends best practices, leading functional projects that drive business improvements. They partner with teams to analyze business trends and facilitate collaboration among team members. This role assesses and reports on the progress of strategic initiatives, contributing to the organization's success.
**Job Description:**


**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
* Identify issues and recommend best practices based on specialized expertise.
  

  
* Lead functional projects and programs that contribute to business improvements.
  

  
* Partner with teams to analyze business trends and inform strategic decisions.
  

  
* Facilitate collaboration among team members to enhance project outcomes.
  

  
* Assess and report on the progress of strategic initiatives within the function.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

  
* 5\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  

  

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**


**Subsidiary:**


PayPal
**Travel Percent:**


0
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us.


For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.


**Our Benefits:**


At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.


**Who We Are:**

  


**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.


**Belonging at PayPal:**


Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.


Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.


We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.
